responsibility: Implements the executable target backend logic for the FR30 port that cannot be expressed purely in macros or RTL patterns. This file provides FR30 target hooks and helper routines for calling conventions and argument passing (including varargs setup, return-value locations, and stack-vs-register decisions), stack-frame and prologue/epilogue bookkeeping via the per-function frame-info structure, register elimination and frame-pointer requirements, operand/constant utility predicates used by the machine description, custom RTL expansion for awkward multiword moves on FR30 addressing/register constraints, and trampoline template/initialization code for nested functions, producing target-specific RTL sequences and assembly support consumed by fr30.md and generic GCC backend code.
same_name_distinction: Contains the FR30 port’s executable C implementation of target hooks and helper routines—such as frame layout/calling-convention code, multiword move expansion, and trampoline generation—that are referenced by fr30.md and parameterized by macros from fr30.h, rather than defining RTL instruction patterns itself or declaring target options in fr30.opt.
